youtube.title: GARDENING WITH WALLY
youtube.summary: Rodney Hide and gardening expert Wally Richards look back at New Zealand gardens of the 1950s and 60s, contrasting rich, worm-filled soil with modern chemical-based practices. Richards recommends natural fertilisers, mineral-rich rock dust and rainwater to support soil health and better-tasting vegetables. They also discuss food security, changing shopping habits and the importance of growing and preserving food at home amid concerns about future weather extremes and supply disruptions.
